filter.category_help: The asset universe to pick from. Each category groups coins by theme (e.g. DeFi, Layer 1, Memes).
filter.top_n_help: How many coins to hold. 'Top 10' means the 10 largest by market cap from your chosen category.
filter.weighting_help: How to distribute money across your holdings. 'Equal' = same amount in each coin. 'MCap' = more money in bigger coins. Others use momentum, volatility, or DeFi metrics.
filter.rebalance_help: How often to re-adjust your portfolio back to target weights. 'Periodic' = fixed schedule. 'Drift Band' = only when a holding drifts too far from its target.
filter.drift_band_title: Rebalance when any holding drifts past a threshold
filter.rebalance_drift: Rebalance when any holding drifts {pct} from target
filter.base_fee_help: Annual management fee charged on the index (like an ETF expense ratio). 0.1% is typical for crypto index products.
filter.spread_mult_help: Simulates trading slippage. 1x = realistic spread costs. Higher values model worse execution (e.g. illiquid markets).
filter.start_from_help: When to start the backtest. 'All' uses the maximum available history. Shorter periods show more recent performance.
filter.regime_overlays_help: Optional rules that adjust your strategy based on market sentiment (Fear & Greed Index) or Bitcoin dominance trends.
filter.fear_greed_help: Adjusts your strategy based on the Crypto Fear & Greed Index (0-100). Hover each mode for a plain-English explanation and backtest results.
filter.btc_dominance_help: Adjusts allocation based on Bitcoin's share of the total crypto market. Hover each mode for a plain-English explanation and backtest results.
filter.vc_overlay_help: Boost or filter coins based on venture capital funding data. Coins backed by top VCs with large recent rounds get higher weight.
filter.sweep_help: Run multiple simulations at once, varying one parameter. Compare how different top N sizes, strategies, or rebalance frequencies perform.

strategy.equal_title:
Equal weight: same $ amount in every coin.
Simplest strategy — no bias toward size or momentum.
Good baseline: outperforms MCap in alt seasons.
Rebalancing sells winners and buys losers (mean-reversion).
strategy.mcap_title:
Market-cap weighted: bigger coins get more $.
Mimics how traditional index funds work (S&P 500 style).
Heavily concentrated in BTC + ETH.
0.5% floor prevents tiny weights on small coins.
strategy.mcap_cap_title:
MCap-weighted with a maximum cap per holding.
Prevents one coin from dominating the portfolio.
Cap 10% → no coin can exceed 10% of portfolio.
Balances MCap efficiency with diversification.
strategy.sqrt_mcap_title:
Square root of market cap weighting.
Dampens concentration vs pure MCap.
BTC still gets more, but mid-caps get a fairer share.
Midway between Equal and MCap.
strategy.momentum_title:
Weight by trailing return over lookback period.
Coins that went up the most get the highest weight.
Classic trend-following factor.
Works well in bull markets, hurts in reversals.
strategy.invvol_title:
Inverse volatility: less volatile = higher weight.
Stable coins get more allocation, volatile ones less.
Reduces portfolio volatility without going to cash.
Good for risk-adjusted returns (Sharpe ratio).
strategy.dual_mom_title:
Dual Momentum: trend-following with cash safety net.
When average coin return > 0: invest normally.
When average < 0: sell everything and go to cash.
Avoids prolonged bear markets entirely.
strategy.risk_parity_title:
Risk parity: each coin contributes equal risk.
Volatile coins get less weight, stable ones more.
Uses covariance matrix for accurate risk budgeting.
Iterative optimization for equal marginal risk.
strategy.min_var_title:
Minimum variance: minimize total portfolio volatility.
Long-only optimization using covariance matrix.
Smoothest equity curve at the cost of lower returns.
Best when you want the least bumpy ride.
strategy.multi_factor_title:
Multi-factor composite: momentum + low vol + MCap.
Ranks coins on each factor, then averages ranks.
Diversified signal — not reliant on one factor.
Best all-rounder for different market regimes.
strategy.low_vol_title:
Low volatility: keep only the least volatile half.
Filters out the most volatile coins entirely.
Remaining coins are equal-weighted.
Defensive play — lower drawdowns, lower returns.
strategy.tvl_title:
Weight by Total Value Locked (TVL).
More TVL = more user trust = higher weight.
Favors established DeFi protocols.
Uses current TVL snapshot (not historical).
strategy.tvl_cap_title:
TVL-weighted with max % cap per holding.
Prevents one protocol from dominating.
Balances TVL signal with diversification.
Cap 10% → no protocol exceeds 10%.
strategy.tvl_sqrt_title:
Square root of TVL: dampened concentration.
Mid-tier protocols get fairer share vs pure TVL.
Reduces dominance of mega-protocols like Lido/Aave.
Middle ground between Equal and TVL.
strategy.fees_w_title:
Weight by 24h protocol fees generated.
Revenue-generating protocols get more weight.
Proxy for real usage and product-market fit.
Uses current fees (not historical).
strategy.revenue_w_title:
Weight by 24h protocol revenue.
Revenue = fees kept by the protocol (not LPs).
Favors protocols with sustainable business models.
Stronger fundamental signal than raw fees.
strategy.volume_w_title:
Weight by 24h trading volume.
More volume = more activity = higher weight.
Favors DEXes and actively traded protocols.
Volatile signal — volume spikes during events.
strategy.tvl_mom_title:
TVL Momentum: weight by TVL growth rate.
Protocols gaining TVL fastest get highest weight.
Uses historical TVL (current / past ratio).
Captures growing protocols before MCap catches up.
strategy.fee_eff_title:
Fee efficiency: fees_24h / TVL ratio.
Measures how much revenue per $ locked.
Favors capital-efficient protocols.
Small protocols with high usage score well.
strategy.yield_w_title:
Weight by max yield APY offered.
Higher yield = higher weight.
Favors protocols offering attractive returns.
Caution: high yields may signal risk.

fng_mode.off_title: No Fear & Greed overlay — use your base strategy as-is.
fng_mode.contrarian_title:
Be greedy when others are fearful. When everyone panics, buy more risky coins. When everyone is euphoric, shift to safer ones.

Why: Classic "buy the dip" logic. Small weight nudges, so the effect is subtle — best with concentrated portfolios.

Backtest: +91% (barely beats baseline). The nudges are too small to matter with 200 holdings.
fng_mode.risk_toggle_title:
A simple on/off switch. When people are scared, ride the winners (momentum). When people are greedy, protect the downside (min variance).

Why: Instead of tweaking weights, it swaps the entire strategy. Binary but effective at extremes.

Backtest: best at 40/60 → +220%, 0.66 Sharpe. Switches often enough to capture regime changes.
fng_mode.cash_shift_title:
When greed is high, move some money to cash. When greed fades, go back to fully invested. That's it.

Why: "Sell when everyone is buying" in its simplest form. Only the greed threshold matters — fear threshold is ignored.

Backtest: best at greed ≥80 → +124%, 0.58 Sharpe. Cash drag hurts in bull markets — you're sitting out while prices rise.
fng_mode.graduated_cash_title:
Smoothly ramp cash as sentiment gets greedier. At peak fear you're fully invested; at peak greed you're partially in cash.

Why: Smoother version of Cash Shift — no sudden all-or-nothing moves. But the cash drag is constant and adds up.

Backtest: best at 15/80 → +76%, 0.48 Sharpe. Underperforms baseline in bull markets — you're always holding some cash.
fng_mode.quality_rotation_title:
The big one. When scared: concentrate into top 5 blue-chips with defensive weighting. When greedy: spread across 50+ coins and ride momentum.

Why: Changes BOTH what you hold (top N) and how you weight it. Fear = flight to quality, greed = catch the altcoin wave.

Backtest: best at 50/55 → +1140%, 0.92 Sharpe. Or 85/90 → +689% with only 62% fees (efficient). Dominant strategy.
fng_mode.trend_follow_title:
Ignores how scared or greedy people are — only cares about the direction. If sentiment is improving, ride momentum. If sentiment is worsening, get defensive.

Why: Catches trend reversals early, before FNG hits extreme levels. No tunable parameters.

Backtest: +159%, 0.71 Sharpe. Solid mid-tier. Best risk-adjusted Sharpe among the simpler strategies.

dom_mode.off_title: No BTC Dominance overlay — use your base strategy as-is.
dom_mode.alts_when_low_title:
When Bitcoin is losing market share (<50%), go wide into altcoins — it's alt season. When Bitcoin dominates (>60%), retreat to the top 5 blue chips.

Why: Alt seasons are where the biggest gains come from. This catches them automatically by watching Bitcoin's share of the total market.

Backtest: +388%, 0.73 Sharpe. Top DOM strategy — simple signal, huge payoff.
dom_mode.alts_when_falling_title:
Watches the direction Bitcoin dominance is moving. If BTC share is dropping → spread into alts. If BTC share is rising → hide in Bitcoin.

Why: Reacts to the trend, not the level. Catches the early move into alt season before dominance hits a threshold.

Backtest: best at 60d → +140%, 0.57 Sharpe. Decent but high fees (94%) from frequent switching.
dom_mode.btc_when_high_title:
When Bitcoin owns >55% of the market, play it safe — concentrate into the top 5 biggest coins. Also gets defensive when BTC dominance is rising.

Why: High BTC dominance usually means alts are bleeding. This dodges alt-season drawdowns by hiding in large caps.

Backtest: best at 90d → +395%, 0.73 Sharpe. Surprisingly strong — nearly matches Alts Low.
dom_mode.combo_title:
Combines Fear & Greed with BTC dominance into 4 scenarios:
• Scared + BTC rising → hide in top 5 (safety)
• Greedy + BTC falling → spread across 100 alts (max risk)
• Scared + BTC falling → defensive alts (cautious)
• Greedy + BTC rising → momentum top 10 (risk-on)

Why: Most sophisticated signal, but complexity doesn't always win.

Backtest: best at 90d → +96%, 0.55 Sharpe. Barely beats baseline — too many conflicting signals.
dom_mode.momentum_title:
If BTC dominance is dropping fast → switch to momentum (ride the altcoin wave). If BTC dominance is rising → switch to MCap weighting (follow the big coins).

Why: Simple trend-following on the BTC/alt rotation. When money flows into alts, chase the winners.

Backtest: best at 30d → +184%, 0.63 Sharpe. Solid middle ground — not the best, not the worst.

vc_mode.funding_title:
Multiply weight by total funding amount.
Coins with more VC backing get higher weight.
Filters to coins matching selected investors & rounds.
vc_mode.valuation_title:
Multiply weight by latest valuation.
Higher-valued projects get more allocation.
Proxy for VC confidence in the project.
vc_mode.fresh_12_title:
Only include coins with funding in last 12 months.
Recently funded = active development.
Multiplied by latest funding amount.
vc_mode.fresh_6_title:
Only include coins with funding in last 6 months.
Most recent VC activity signal.
Stricter filter than Fresh 12m.
